entities.name: UDP-MurNAc-DAP ligase
observations: The 510-aa query sequence is homologous to reviewed bacterial UDP-MurNAc-L-Ala-D-Glu–meso-DAP ligases at 43.1–46.4% identity and 92.7–97.1% query coverage; inferred activity EC 6.3.2.13.
Reference annotations support ATP- and Mg2+-dependent ligation of meso-2,6-diaminopimelate to UDP-MurNAc-L-Ala-D-Glu during peptidoglycan biosynthesis.

entities.name: UDP-MurNAc-DAP ligation
observations: RHEA:23676: UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-muramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate + meso-2,6-diaminopimelate + ATP = UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-muramoyl-L-alanyl-gamma-D-glutamyl-meso-2,6-diaminopimelate + ADP + phosphate + H+.
